Gables read as clean triangles with no protruding wedge fins; orientation correct from all sides
Proportion reads as a house at 5-stud character scale; textured materials + chimney pots + door hood clear the above-generic bar
Only minor weakness: eave windows read as thin slots and gable window as a plain opening, but do not break the cottage read

steps: get_references('english stone cottage') and listed signature features: whitewash rough stone, steep terracotta pitched roof, gable-end chimney above ridge, small dark windows, eave-side door with hood
Built floor + 4 walls (Cobblestone, whitewash color) from primitives; front wall segmented (FrontLeft/Right/Lintel) to leave a real 4x7 door opening

capture_angles front/iso/left/right: caught inverted gable wedges reading as eave fins, swapped each half's yaw so full-height edge lands at ridge center, re-captured to confirm clean triangular gables

recipe.text: Distinct concept vs prior houses: whitewashed cobblestone cottage with terracotta gable roof and a prominent end-gable stone chimney. Ridge runs along the 24-stud X axis; gable triangles built from mirrored WedgeParts (thin in X) tucked under a 27-stud overhanging roof. Front eave wall carries a genuine 4w x 7h door hole (character fits) via segmented panels + lintel; windows are dark-framed inset panes with stone sills. Materials: Cobblestone walls (whitewash), Slate roof (terracotta), stone chimney. Only rebuild needed was the gable wedge orientation (swap yaw so the full-height edge sits at the ridge).
